title: Network Info & Speed Monitor
summary: Diagnostic panel that reports public IP details and can show live WAN bandwidth. The panel also reports offline state when no provider can be reached.

items.title: Live Speed Monitor
items.description: Prints real-time download and upload rates for the active WAN interface once per second.
items.usage_tip: Press Ctrl+C to stop the monitor and return to the menu.

items.title: Refresh Information
items.description: Re-queries public IP providers (ipwho.is, ipapi.co, ifconfig.co) for IP, country, ISP and ASN.
items.usage_tip: Use it after switching WAN or reconnecting a tunnel.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed; the panel is read-only.
